text: Besides having roughly symmetric repressor strengths, what additional condition is necessary for bistability in the Gardner-Cantor-Collins genetic toggle switch?
choices: A third repressor forming a closed ring
An orthogonal T7 RNA polymerase driving both promoters
A high-copy-number plasmid backbone exceeding 100 copies
Cooperativity: a Hill coefficient greater than 1 for at least one repressor
explanation: Bistability also requires sufficient nonlinearity, i.e. a Hill coefficient greater than 1 for at least one repressor, so that the two nullclines intersect three times (two stable states and one unstable state). A third repressor forming a ring describes the repressilator oscillator, not the two-repressor toggle switch. An orthogonal T7 system and plasmid copy number can affect absolute expression levels but are not the defining mathematical condition for bistability.
